scope: Read-only postcapture acceptance preparation. No capture, browser, provider, database, process control or release acceptance performed. Original Meet owner alone owns private-window execution and cleanup.
observations: Private self-only event metadata reports authenticated actor and organizer account, confirmed private Meet conference, zero attendees; this proves creation/readback only.

Managed-login runtime reports driver-ready and authenticationVerified=false. Account diagnostic reports login_redirect; prejoin diagnostic reports sign_in_visible_no_account_control. Neither establishes a signed-in Meet receiver.

Generated local audio/video and controlled-av provider/replay evidence are GENERATEDTESTINPUT, not receiver-side Meet capture. Prior 12.650958-second audio/approximately 15-second AV, 172-byte response, [0,30] rejection and no publication remain explicit.

Cycle3 bounded duration repair has scoped checker acceptance attributed in its packet; whole U4.1 and actual Meet-to-Ask remain HOLD. No live raw receiver artifact reference was supplied in the bounded qa/.cache/webinar inventory.

awaitedOutputs.required: Original owner supplies run UUID, current exact-account visible authenticated observation at receiver join, event/readback reference and hashes, join occurrence/time, receiver/presenter roles, owned profile and controller/browser PID+creation time+executable fingerprints, recorder fake-device absence and mic/camera off. Login logs or provider event ownership alone insufficient.

Receiver-side admitted Meet observation plus time-bound actual reception of generated phrase and changing frame-counter video from the separate presenter. Distinguish emitted local fixture from network-received content. Preserve sanitized progress events, timestamps, capture backend and exact run linkage.

Original raw receiver capture absolute path, exact-byte SHA256, size, UTC interval, independently probed duration and audiovisual streams; derivative paths/hashes and conversion/time-origin lineage. Inspect actual playback for audible recognizable phrase and changing frames; silence, frozen image, stream metadata or nonempty bytes alone insufficient.

Exact candidate source inventory hash, commands, exit status and stdout for actual file submission/Python queue operations/model+available usage; raw provider response reference/hash; recording adapter consumption, schema and finite in-range turn timings; published source/session/turn artifacts bound to actual receiver media and preserved labels/text/provenance. Include successful below-30-second actual provider sample on current bytes without substituting old generated fixture for Meet proof.

Owner exports isolated-work-DB tenant/session/source readback, current-generation input-media/hash proof and every required indexing outcome. Cited Ask request/response exports must resolve exact same tenant/session/turn IDs, contain literal supporting transcript spans and bounded timestamps; demonstrate immediate downstream consumption and media-supported content. No checker DB/provider call in this preparation.

Original owner supplies sanitized terminal logs and fresh exact PID+creation+executable/profile ownership proof of owned receiver/presenter/controller closure, locks/extensions/control state cleanup, preservation of raw artifacts; shared Chrome worker unaffected. Live process list alone without known fingerprints insufficient; no broad kill or private-window control by checker.

acceptanceRules: No PASS until all applicable awaited outputs exist and independently verify; distinguish bounded U4.1 C10 subset from Meet reception and portable-release L1 real-webinar/sustained/restart/Ubuntu obligations.

Synthetic generated fixture is acceptable as labeled private-test input; evidence must show it crossed the actual Meet presenter-to-receiver route. This test does not establish an unattended real webinar or continuous operation.
Bind all evidence to one owned run, media bytes, account, tenant, session, generation and candidate source inventory; refuse cross-run/stale proof.
Actual playback and changing frame content are mandatory for live-media acceptance; numeric activity is supporting evidence only.
Schema/timing failures, missing citations, failed required stage or missing ownership cleanup preserve HOLD. Human identity/external truth and release acceptance remain separate.

minimalIndependentReadOnlyCommands.purpose: Exact raw and downstream byte identity after absolute owned paths arrive
minimalIndependentReadOnlyCommands.command: $ownedArtifacts | ForEach-Object { Get-Item -LiteralPath $_ | Select-Object FullName,Length; Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_ -Algorithm SHA256 }
minimalIndependentReadOnlyCommands.prerequisite: Owner supplies explicit existing capture/derivative/provider/turn/index/Ask/evidence paths; do not enumerate unrelated media.
